newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - Feb 28.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

An 18 per cent swing to Labour secured a momentous victory for Tony Blair's party in the Wirral South by-election. An unusually high voter turnout added to Tory woes, undermining the argument that this defeat only marked a protest vote.
UNION SUITOR LEWIS PLAYS A SOLO GAME

Joe Lewis's English National Investment Company has emerged as the only interested party in the former discount house, Union . Lewis, who has a 40 million stg stake in Glasgow Rangers is expected to make a cash and shares offer of 110p a share.
POUND ON THE RUN AFTER DRUBBING FOR TORIES Sterling fell back as news of the Conservative by-election defeat was digested by traders.
HOOK SET TO PULL IN LLOYD'S 200,000 STG

Former director of fund management group Ivory & Sine, Colin Hook is set to become head of an action group in the Lloyd's insurance market. Hook left I&S amid strong criticisms of his managerial style.
